stem:
Veena sees Gregorian dates on her school planner and also dates from the Indian National Calendar used on official government papers. Some calendars track the Moon; some are solar.

How should the Indian National Calendar be classified?

options.text: an official solar calendar used along with the Gregorian calendar
a lunar calendar based only on the phases of the Moon
a private calendar used only for school festivals
an international calendar that has replaced the Gregorian calendar

teacher.key_rationale: The Indian National Calendar is an official solar calendar used with the Gregorian calendar. Calling it lunar swaps solar for lunar. Limiting it to private festivals narrows its official use. Saying it replaced the Gregorian calendar reverses their side-by-side status.
